title: AI Hack Night
description: An overnight hackathon where teams compete to build AI-powered solutions to real campus problems. Open to all skill levels.

title: Robotics Townhall
description: An open forum to showcase ongoing robotics projects, discuss upcoming competitions, and welcome new members to the society.

title: Town Hall — Culinary Club
description: A lively gathering where members share recipes, plan the semester's food festivals, and taste dishes from across the country.

title: Open Source Sprint
description: A one-day coding sprint where participants contribute pull requests to selected open-source projects under mentor guidance.

title: Battle of Bands
description: Student bands face off in a night of live music spanning rock, jazz, classical fusion, and everything in between.

title: Inter-College Football Tournament
description: A two-day football knockout tournament hosted by BML Munjal University, open to teams from colleges across the NCR.

title: Annual Chess Championship
description: A Swiss-system chess tournament open to all students. Trophies and certificates for the top three finishers.

title: UI/UX Design Bootcamp
description: A hands-on full-day workshop covering Figma fundamentals, design systems, and prototyping—from wireframe to pixel-perfect mockup.

title: Public Speaking Workshop
description: An interactive workshop on voice modulation, storytelling, and confident delivery, led by an industry communication coach.
